h1: Live Music for Your Wedding Day
heroImageAlt: Conor Pederson playing acoustic guitar outdoors under the moon
intro: Conor plays live for weddings and private events — vocals and acoustic guitar across Pop, R&B, Country, Hip‑Hop, and the classics, adaptable from a quiet ceremony processional to a reception that gets people dancing. He books within about 100 miles of Pittsburgh, direct, with no marketplace listing fee added to your quote.

sections.heading: Ceremony, Cocktail Hour & Reception
sections.body: One solo act can cover the whole day: a stripped-back processional and vows, a warm cocktail-hour set while your guests mingle, then a reception set that builds toward the songs everyone actually wants to dance to. No band changeover, no second vendor to coordinate.

sections.heading: Service Area
sections.body: Home base is Pittsburgh. Bookings typically stay within about 100 miles — the South Hills, North Hills, Washington and Westmoreland counties, plus Morgantown and Wheeling, West Virginia, and Youngstown, Ohio. Venue further out? Ask.

sections.heading: Why Book Direct
sections.body: Sites like GigSalad, The Bash, and WeddingWire are useful for browsing, but every booking through them carries a platform fee. Book Conor directly here and that fee disappears — and you're emailing the person who'll actually be playing your wedding, not a listing account.

faqs.q: What does Conor play at a wedding?
faqs.a: Solo vocals and acoustic guitar, spanning Pop, R&B, Country, Hip-Hop, and the classics — built to cover ceremony, cocktail hour, and reception without a band changeover.

Most weddings stay within about 100 miles of Pittsburgh — the South Hills, North Hills, Washington and Westmoreland counties, Morgantown and Wheeling WV, and Youngstown OH. Ask about anything further out.
Use the form on this page or email conorpedersonmusic@gmail.com with your date, venue, and event type. You'll hear back directly from Conor.

faqs.q: Can he learn our first-dance song or take requests?
faqs.a: Send your must-play list when you book — he'll work new material into the set for the songs that matter most to your day.

faqs.q: How far in advance should we book?
faqs.a: As soon as you have a date. Popular wedding dates fill a venue's calendar well ahead of the event, so reaching out early is the safest move.
